summary: The root قبل (qbl) primarily means to face or come forward.
lane: 4 أَقْبَلْتُهُ الشَّىْءَ ذ I made it to face the thing: (S, K:) and الشَّىْءَ app. signifies the same: see a verse of El-Aashà voce اِرْتِسَامٌ . -b2- أَقْبَلَ بِهِ [ He turned it forward; contr. of أَدْبَرَ بِهِ ]. (S, K, art. دبر .) -b3- أَقْبَلَ He came, facing; (JK, S, * K; *) came forward; came on; advanced; contr. of أَدْبَرَ . (S, K.) -b4- أَقْبَلْتُ قِبَلَكَ [not قُبْلَكَ ] I advanced, or came, toward thee. Like قَصَدْتُ قَصْدَكَ . (L, art. حرد .) See also Kur, ii. 172. -b5- أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ He advanced, or approached, towards him, or it. -b6- أَقْبَلَ عَلَى إِنْسَانٍ , as though he desired no other person. (JK.) -b7- اقْبَالٌ The advancing of fortune; contr. of إِدْبَارٌ . -b8- الإِقْبَالُ فِى الدُّنْيَا [ Advance in the world, or in worldly circumstances ]. (Mgh in art. جد .) إِقْبَالٌ signifies The being fortunate. (KL.) -b9- إِقْبَالٌ i. q. دَوْلَةٌ [ Good fortune; &c.; see تامِكُ ]: and عِزَّةٌ [ might; &c.]. (Kull, p. 64.) -b10- أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ He showed favour to him: or, more properly, he presented a favourable aspect to him; or, accord. to general usage, he met him kindly; see بَشَّ لَهُ . -b11- أَقْبَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ الدُّنْيَا , (A, art. فتح ,) The world favoured him. -b12- أَقْبَلَ عَلَى شَىْءٍ He set about, or commenced, doing a thing. (K, &c.) -b13- See تَصَدَّدَ . -b14- أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ He clave to it: and he took to, set about, began, or commenced it; as also عليه . (K.) -b15- [ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ بِالسَّيْفِ , and بِالعَصَا , and بِالسَّوْطِ He advanced against him, or set upon him, with the sword, and with the staff or stick, and with the whip. ] -b16- You say, أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْه بِالسَّوْطِ يَضْرِبُهُ [ He advanced against him, or set upon him, with the whip, striking him ]. (S in art. حول .) -b17- See قَبَلٌ . -b18- يُقْبِلُ بِالدَّلْوِ إِلَى البِئْرِ and أَمْرُ فُلَانٍ الَى إِقْبَالٍ : see أَدْبَرَ . -b19- أَقْبَل عَلَيْهِ بِالتَّعْنِيفِ : see Har, p. 165 -b20- أَقْبِلْ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ [ Betake, or apply, thyself to thine own affairs ]. (T, voce إِلَى .) -b21- دَبَرَتْ لَهُ الرِّيحُ بَعْدَ مَا أَقْبَلَتْ : see دبر . -b22- أَقْبَلَ [ He recovered, or regained, health; ] occurring in the K, as the explanation of ثَابَ جِسْمُهُ . (K, art. ثوب .) أَقْبَلَ بَعْدَ هُزَالٍ . (K, voce حَشَمَ .) -b23- أَقْبَلَ , with reference to the slit ear of a she-camel: see أَدْبَرَ . -b24- أَقْبِلْنَا بِذِمَّةٍ , app. a mistranscription for أَقْلِبْنَا : see ذِمَّةٌ .

headwords.gloss: He took, received; admitted, willingly; with approbation; he accepted

parts.t: قَبَحَ اللّٰهُ مَا قَبَلَ مِنْهُ وَمَا دَبَرَ

headwords.def: قَبَلَ as syn. with , q. v.: see أَدْبَرَ , in two places. قَبَحَ اللّٰهُ مَا قَبَلَ مِنْهُ وَمَا دَبَرَ : see دَبَر . قَبِلَ He took, received, or admitted, willingly, or with approbation; he accepted. See قَبُولٌ . قَبِلَتِ النَّعْلُ The sandal had its قِبَال broken. (TA in art. شسع .)

headwords.gloss: He faced; fronted; was opposite to

parts.t: He requited such a thing with such a thing;
gave, such a thing in return for such a thing;
as good for good, evil for evil, good for evil, or evil for good. (The Lexicons passim.)
He counteracted such a thing with such a thing.
see an ex. of the part. n. voce
A horse that is generous with respect to both parents.

headwords.def: قَابَلَهُ He faced, or fronted, or was opposite to or over against, him, or it. (S, * K.) See also He, or it, corresponded to him, or it. قَابَلَهُ بِنَفْسِهِ [ He opposed himself to him ]. (TA, art. عرض .) See عَرَضَ لَهُ ; and see 4. قَابَلَ كَذَا بِكَذَا He requited such a thing with such a thing; or did, or gave, such a thing in return for such a thing; as good for good, evil for evil, good for evil, or evil for good. (The Lexicons passim.) He counteracted such a thing with such a thing. He compared such a thing &c. قُوبِلَ بِكَذَا It was compensated, or requited, by, or with, such a thing: see an ex. of the part. n. voce غُنْمٌ . قَابَلَ الشَّاة : see دَابَرَ الشاة . فَرَسٌ قُوبِلَ مِنْ آفِقٍ وَآفِقَةٍ A horse that is generous with respect to both parents.

(S, K, art. دبر .) أَقْبَلَ He came, facing; (JK, S, * K; *) came forward; came on; advanced; contr. of أَدْبَرَ . (S, K.) أَقْبَلْتُ قِبَلَكَ [not قُبْلَكَ ] I advanced, or came, toward thee. Like قَصَدْتُ قَصْدَكَ . (L, art. حرد .) See also Kur, ii. 172. أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ He advanced, or approached, towards him, or it. أَقْبَلَ عَلَى إِنْسَانٍ , as though he desired no other person. headwords.gloss: They faced; confronted, one another
headwords.def: تَقَابَلُوا They faced, or confronted, one another: see S in art. فقح .

headwords.gloss: He began it; commenced it

parts.t: namely, an affair; (S, * Mgh, K; *) as also

headwords.def: اِقْتَبَلَهُ He began it, or commenced it; namely, an affair; (S, * Mgh, K; *) as also . (Mgh.)

headwords.gloss: He faced him; it; He turned his face towards him

parts.t: He turned his face towards him,
He went to meet him; he met him,
encountered him. He saw it before him: he looked forward to it: he saw it,
knew, at the beginning of it what he did not see,
he accused him, to his face, of a thing that he disliked,
اَلبْهتُ ٱسْتِقْبَالُكَ أَخَاكَ بِمَا لَيْسَ فِيهِ

headwords.def: اِسْتَقْبَلَهُ : see اِسْتَدْبَرَهُ . He faced him, or it. (TA) He turned his face towards him, or it. He came before his face. He went to meet him; he met him, or encountered him. He saw it before him: he looked forward to it: he saw it, or knew it, beforehand. He saw, or knew, at the beginning of it what he did not see, or know, at the end thereof. استقبلهُ بِأَمْرٍ (T, S, K, &c., in art. بده ) He met him, or encountered him, with a thing. or an affair, or an action. (TK in art. بده .) استقبلهُ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ (A, K, in art. بكت , &c.) He encountered him with, or, as it often means, he accused him, to his face, of a thing that he disliked, or hated: see بَكَّتَهُ ; and the phrases اَلبْهتُ ٱسْتِقْبَالُكَ أَخَاكَ بِمَا لَيْسَ فِيهِ and بِالكَذبِ

headwords.gloss: Before; contr. of

parts.t: ; (S, K, &c.;) an adv. n. of time; and, as some say, of place also; (MF, TA;) and of rank, or station. (TA.)

headwords.def: قَبْلُ Before; contr. of بَعْدُ ; (S, K, &c.;) an adv. n. of time; and, as some say, of place also; (MF, TA;) and of rank, or station. (TA.)

headwords.gloss: He poured the water into the trough while his camels were drinking, so that it came upon them; bringing his camels to water, and drawing the water over their mouths, not having prepared for them aught; thereof

parts.t: He poured the water into the trough while his camels were drinking, so that it came upon them:
bringing his camels to water, and drawing the water over their mouths, not having prepared for them aught
he poured the water over the mouths of his camels:
he drew the water over the heads of his camels while they drank,
when they had drunk what was in the trough,
not having prepared it before that:
and this is the most severe mode of watering. (Lh, TA.) ee an ex. voce

headwords.def: سَقَىإِبِلَهُ قَبَلًا [and بِالقَبَلِ ] He poured the water into the trough while his camels were drinking, so that it came upon them: (T, TA:) or قَبَلٌ signifies a man's bringing his camels to water, and drawing the water over their mouths, not having prepared for them aught [ thereof ] before that: (As, TA:) and سَقَى عَلَى إِبِلِهِ قَبَلًا he poured the water over the mouths of his camels: (M, TA:) and عَلَى إِبِلِهِ he drew the water over the heads of his camels while they drank, when they had drunk what was in the trough, (Lh, M, TA,) not having prepared it before that: and this is the most severe mode of watering. (Lh, TA.) ee an ex. voce جَبًا , art. جبو and جبى . نَبَلٌ is opposed to دَبَرٌ : see the latter. نَّ الحَقَّ بِقَبَلٍ

headwords.gloss: I met him face to face; i. q; I will not speak to thee until ten

parts.t: I met him face to face.
لَا أُكَلِّمُكَ اِلَى عَشْرٍ مِنْ ذِى قِبَلٍ
I will not speak to thee until ten
What is next to a thing:
he went to the part next to the market
I have property in his hands;

headwords.def: لَقِيتُهُ قِبَلًا I met him face to face. (JK.) لَا أُكَلِّمُكَ اِلَى عَشْرٍ مِنْ ذِى قِبَلٍ i. q. من ذى , i. e. [ I will not speak to thee until ten nights] in what I [ now ] begin [ of time ]: or the latter, until ten [nights] which thou [ now ] beginnest: and the former, until ten [nights] of the days which thou [ now ] witnessest, (K, TA,) i. e. beginnest: (TA:) or the latter, of a time [ now ] begun; or, a future time. (Mgh, Msb.) And أَتَيْتُ قُلَانًا مَنُ ذِى قِبَلٍ i. q. آنِفًا . (Lth in T, art. انف .) قِبَلَ Towards. (Bd. ii. 172.) قِبَلُ شَىْءُ What is next to a thing: you say, َهَبَ قِبَلَ السُّوقِ [ he went to the part next to the market ]. (TA.) لِى قِبَلَهُ مَالٌ I have property in his hands; i. e. due, or owing, to me by him; syn. عِنْدَهُ [q. v.] (K, * TA.) And

headwords.gloss: front; fore part; former

parts.t: ] of a man or woman; (Msb;) opposite of

headwords.def: قُبُلٌ The front, or fore part. See Kur, xii. 26. The former or first part: see دَفَئِيٌّ . القُبُلُ The anterior pudendum ( فَرْج ) [ vulva, and vagina, ] of a man or woman; (Msb;) opposite of الدُّبُرُ . (S, K.)
مَا لَهُ قِبْلَةٌ وَلَا دِبْرَةٌ , &c.: see دبر .
قَبَلِىٌّ : see دَبَرِىٌّ .
قِبَالُ الشِّبْرِ and الشِّسْعِ : see شِبْرٌ . فُلَانٌ مَا يَدْرِى قِبَالَ الأَمْرِ مَنْ دِبَارِهِ ; &c.: see دبر . قبَالٌ of the sandal: see زِمَامٌ .

headwords.gloss: Favourable reception; acceptance; approbation; love; approbation

parts.t: Approbation is bestowed upon such a one;
it, is an appearance of goodliness,

headwords.def: قَبُولٌ Favourable reception; acceptance; approbation: (KL PS:) love, and approbation, and inclination of the mind. (TA.) عَلَى فُلَانٍ قَبُولٌ [ Approbation is bestowed upon such a one; ] the mind accepts, or approves, such a one. (S.) قَبُولٌ Goodliness, beauty, grace, comeliness, or pleasingness: and [ beauty of ] aspect or garb. (K.) [And Acceptableness. عَلَيْهِ قَبُولٌ may be rendered Upon him, or it, is an appearance of goodliness, &c.]

headwords.gloss: Kind, species, class, race; Of the kind, &c
headwords.def: قَبِيلٌ : see دَبِيرٌ . قَبِيلٌ Kind, species, class, race. مِنْ قً Of the kind, &c. See قَبِيلَةٌ .

headwords.gloss: He came a little while ago

parts.t: He came a little while ago;

headwords.def: جَآءَ قُبَيْلَ He came a little while ago; syn. آنِفًا . (M in art. انف .)

headwords.gloss: Opposite to, in a position so as to face, him; it; direction, point, place, or tract, in front

direction, point, place, or tract, in front

headwords.def: قُبَالَتَهُ Opposite to, in a position so as to face, him or it. (K, &c.) See حِيَالٌ in art. حول . قُبَالَةٌ The direction, point, place, or tract, in front of a thing; the opposite direction &c.

headwords.gloss: A body of men from one father and mother; a body of men from several ancestors; A mass of stone

rock at the mouth of a well.

headwords.def: قَبِيلَةٌ A body of men from one father and mother: and , without ة , a body of men from several ancestors. (Az in TA, art. سبط .) قَبِيلَةٌ : see شَعْبٌ . A mass of stone or rock at the mouth of a well. (K and TA voce عُقَابٌ , q. v.) See قَابِلٌ .

headwords.gloss: A nextcoming year; i. q; The next night
headwords.def: عَامٌ قَابِلٌ , and , signify the same, [ A nextcoming year ]. (S.) القَابِلَةُ i. q. اللَّيْلَةُ المُقْبِلَةُ [ The next night ]. (S, K.) See القُبَاقِبُ . قَابِلٌ لِكَذَا Susceptible of such a thing. قَابِلٌ An arrow that wins [in the game of المَيْسِر ]; (TA, art دبر ;) contr. of دَابِرٌ , q. v. (S and TA, art. دبر .) قَبَائِل of the head: see شَأْنٌ . And of a helmet: see طِرَاقٌ . قَابِلَةٌ A wife. (TA in art. عزب .)

headwords.gloss: The quality of admitting; receiving; susceptibility
headwords.def: قَابِلِيَّةٌ [ The quality of admitting or receiving; susceptibility ].

headwords.gloss: More; most, inclined to accept admonition
headwords.def: أَقْبَلُ لِلْمَوْعِظَةِ [ More, or most, inclined to accept admonition ]. (TA, art. رق .]
إِقْبَالَةٌ and its syn. إِقْبَالٌ : see 4; and see إِدْبَارَةٌ .

headwords.gloss: I. q
headwords.def: مُقْبِلٌ : see قَابِلٌ . [ I. q. مُقْتَبَلٌ ]. Ex. مَقْبِلَةٌ الرَّحْمِ (K, voce جَوَارِحُ ,) and الشَّبَابِ . (TA, ibid.) See مَدْبِرٌ .

headwords.def: المُقَابَلُ مِنَ المَنَازِلِ contr. of المُدَابَرُ , (M, art. دبر , q. v.) مُقَابَلٌ Noble, by the father's and mother's side: (S, K, TA:) see an ex. voce طَابٌ ; and see إِزْدَوَجَا . مُقَابَلَةٌ applied to a ewe: see مُدَبَرَةٌ . نَاقَةٌ مُقَابَلَةٌ مُدَابَرَةٌ : see دبر . الجَبْرُ والمُقَابَلَةُ : see جبر . فِى مُقَابَلَةِ كَذَا In comparison with such a thing: see an ex. in art. غين in the Msb.
